"""Record actual local checks for the current W.1 guide, without claiming Colab or offline coverage."""
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm')
now=lambda:datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def section(path,lesson):
 raw=(root/path).read_bytes()
 matches=list(re.finditer(rb'(?m)^## ([A-Z\d]+\.\d+) [^\r\n]+',raw))
 for i,h in enumerate(matches):
  if h[1].decode()==lesson:
   return raw[h.start():matches[i+1].start() if i+1<len(matches) else len(raw)]
 raise ValueError(lesson)
started=now()
source='course/first-steps.md'
body=section(source,'W.1')
reference='course/chapters/01.md'
refbody=section(reference,'1.1')
fences=re.findall(r'```python\n(.*?)\n```',refbody.decode(),re.S)
assert len(fences)==1
assert 'text = "貓看狗，狗看貓。"' in body.decode()
assert 'text = "鳥看狗，狗看鳥。"' in body.decode()
assert fences[0].count('text = "貓看狗，狗看貓。"')==1
examples=[('environment_check','import runpy\nrunpy.run_path("scripts/check_env.py", run_name="__main__")\n'),('referenced_original',fences[0]),('guide_exercise_bird',fences[0].replace('text = "貓看狗，狗看貓。"','text = "鳥看狗，狗看鳥。"'))]
env={**os.environ,'OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1','MKL_NUM_THREADS':'1'}
records=[]
for name,program in examples:
 command=[str(root/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',program]
 r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 if name=='environment_check': assert re.search(r'^compute\s+OK（cpu）$',r.stdout,re.M),r.stdout
 if name=='referenced_original': assert r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1]=='貓看狗，狗看貓。',r.stdout
 if name=='guide_exercise_bird': assert r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1]=='鳥看狗，狗看鳥。',r.stdout
 records.append({'case':name,'program':program,'program_sha256':sha(program.encode()),'command':command,'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr})
version=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(root/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c','import json,platform;print(json.dumps({"python":platform.python_version(),"platform":platform.platform()}))'],text=True,cwd=root))
assert section(source,'W.1')==body and section(reference,'1.1')==refbody,'Reviewed source changed during checks'
r={'schema_version':1,'started_at':started,'checked_at':now(),'status':'passed','lesson_id':'W.1','source':source+'#W.1','source_sha256':sha(body),'scope':'Actual local CPU environment check and direct execution of the guide-referenced 1.1 Python example and bird-text exercise. W.1 has no generated notebook. This does not claim execution of Git/uv installation, PowerShell, Jupyter browser interactions, Colab, GPU, or full-book offline behavior.','command':'.venv/bin/python /tmp/verify-corrected-guide-w1.py','environment':{**version,'omp_num_threads':'1','mkl_num_threads':'1'},'result':{'total':3,'passed':3,'failed':0},'reference':{'source':reference+'#1.1','source_sha256':sha(refbody)},'repository_sources':{'scripts/check_env.py':sha((root/'scripts/check_env.py').read_bytes())},'records':records,'verification_program':Path(__file__).read_text()}
p=root/'docs/validation-artifacts/technical-revision-W.1-guide-code.json'
p.write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'receipt':str(p.relative_to(root)),'status':'passed','cases':3,'source_sha256':r['source_sha256']}))
